Diluted EPS: $(0.05) for 6M 2026, versus $— for 6M 2025 (loss per Class B share; prior year had no comparable EPS).
Business purpose: Formed as a Cayman Islands blank check company to pursue one or more business combinations.
Operations status: No operating revenues to date; activities limited to formation, IPO readiness and due diligence.
Capital deployment: Completed an IPO and placed proceeds in a Trust to fund a target acquisition and post‑combination operations.
Use of funds: Funds outside the Trust are reserved for target identification, due diligence, travel and transaction structuring.
